subject: DI03000141

intro_text.en: Diagram-first notes: identify parts, understand construction, follow working and practise only the syllabus numericals.
intro_text.gu: પહેલાં labelled diagram, પછી parts, Construction અને step-by-step Working. Syllabus પ્રમાણે જ numericals.

body.en:
Construction: a heavy rotating rim or disc is connected by arms/web to a hub on the shaft. Mass far from the axis contributes strongly to moment of inertia I. It must be supported, balanced, guarded and designed against rotational stress.

Working: when driving torque exceeds resisting torque, the flywheel accelerates and stores kinetic energy; when it is less, the flywheel slows and returns energy. It reduces cyclic speed fluctuation but cannot create energy or maintain mean speed after a persistent load increase. A governor serves that different purpose.
body.gu:
Construction: heavy rim/disc, arms/web અને shaft hub. Axis થી દૂર mass moment of inertia I વધારે. Support,balance,guard અને rotational stress design જરૂરી.

Working: driving torque>resisting torque હોય ત્યારે energy store કરી speed વધે; ઓછું હોય ત્યારે energy આપે અને speed ઘટે. Cyclic fluctuation ઘટાડે, energy બનાવતું નથી; persistent load change પછી mean speed regulate કરવાનું governor નું કાર્ય છે.

h.en: 5.1.2 Turning-moment diagram: signed area means energy
h.gu: 5.1.2 Turning-moment Diagram: Signed Area એટલે Energy

body.en:
Plot driving torque vertically against crank angle horizontally; the mean resisting-torque line represents steady external load in the ideal cycle. Area above it is surplus work; below it is deficit work. Work=integral(T dtheta), with theta in radians for joules.

Maximum fluctuation of energy is the difference between maximum and minimum accumulated surplus-energy levels over the cycle. It is NOT always the largest single lobe or the sum of all positive lobes. Integrate/accumulate signed areas from a reference point; the total cycle surplus is zero in periodic steady operation.
body.gu:
Vertical driving torque અને horizontal crank angle; mean resisting-torque line external load બતાવે. Line ઉપર surplus work, નીચે deficit. Work=integral(T dtheta), joules માટે theta radians.

Cycle ના accumulated surplus-energy levels માં maximum−minimum એટલે maximum fluctuation ΔE. ફક્ત largest lobe અથવા બધા positive lobes નો sum નહિ. Signed areas sequentially ઉમેરો; periodic steady state માં cycle total surplus zero.

body.en:
Construction context: steam acts alternately on both sides of a piston, and a connecting rod/crank transforms reciprocation into rotation. The double-acting arrangement gives a driving event on each half revolution, unlike a four-stroke single-cylinder IC engine.

Working interpretation: gas pressure force and crank leverage change through each stroke, giving two broad torque lobes per revolution in a simplified diagram. Flywheel exchanges energy between above-mean and below-mean regions. Real curves depend on admission/cut-off, expansion, back pressure, inertia and geometry; the provided curve is a labelled teaching shape, not measured data or a design prediction.
body.gu:
Double-acting steam engine માં piston ની બંને sides પર alternate steam act કરે; rod/crank rotation આપે. દરેક half revolution માં driving event, four-stroke IC થી અલગ.

Pressure force અને crank leverage બદલાતાં simplified diagram માં revolution દીઠ બે broad torque lobes. Flywheel mean-line ઉપર/નીચે energy exchange કરે. Actual curve admission,cut-off,expansion,back pressure,inertia,geometry પર આધારિત; diagram measured data નથી.

body.en:
A four-stroke cycle spans720° or two crank revolutions: intake, compression, power and exhaust. Only the power stroke supplies the principal positive gas-work impulse; compression and pumping strokes require energy, while inertia also alters shaft torque.

The flywheel stores part of power-stroke surplus and returns it during deficits. With one firing event per two revolutions, speed irregularity can be large compared with multi-cylinder arrangements. Mark stroke boundaries and the mean torque line on the schematic. Actual torque may change sign and its extrema do not necessarily occur exactly at stroke boundaries.
body.gu:
Four-stroke cycle720°: intake,compression,power,exhaust. મુખ્ય positive gas-work impulse power stroke માં; compression/pumping energy લે; inertia પણ shaft torque બદલે.

Flywheel power-stroke surplus store કરીને deficits દરમિયાન પાછું આપે. બે revolutions દીઠ એક firing હોવાથી single cylinder માં irregularity વધુ હોઈ શકે. Stroke boundaries/mean line label કરો. Actual extrema હંમેશાં boundary પર નથી.

body.en:
Coefficient of speed fluctuation Cs=(omega_max−omega_min)/omega_mean=(Nmax−Nmin)/Nmean. In the usual small-fluctuation design approximation, maximum energy fluctuation ΔE=I omega_mean² Cs. Stored kinetic energy at a given speed is E=I omega²/2; this is not the same as the exchanged ΔE.

Coefficient of energy fluctuation CE=ΔE/Wcycle. Cycle work equals power × cycle time: for a four-stroke single-cylinder engine tcycle=120/N seconds with N in rpm; for a one-revolution cycle use60/N. For a thin rim I≈mR²; hubs/arms/disc require their own inertia contributions.
body.gu:
Cs=(Nmax−Nmin)/Nmean, angular-speed form પણ same. Usual small-fluctuation design માં ΔE=I omega_mean² Cs. Stored E=Iomega²/2 અને exchanged ΔE એક નથી.

CE=ΔE/Wcycle; Wcycle=P×cycle time. Four-stroke single cylinder માટે120/N seconds; one-revolution cycle60/N. Thin rim I≈mR²; hub/arms/disc inertia અલગ ગણવા.

h.en: 5.1.6 Flywheel numerical with a clear cycle basis

body.en:
A single-cylinder four-stroke engine develops10 kW at300 rpm. Let CE=.10 and permitted Cs=.02; assume a thin rim at mean radius.50 m. Cycle time=120/300=.40 s; Wcycle=10000×.40=4000 J. Therefore ΔE=.10×4000=400 J.

omega=2pi×300/60=31.416 rad/s; I=400/(31.416²×.02)=20.264 kg·m². Rim mass=I/R²=20.264/.25=81.06 kg. This is an ideal inertia requirement, not a complete safe flywheel design. Using60/N for this four-stroke cycle would incorrectly halve the calculated cycle work.
body.gu:
Four-stroke single-cylinder10kW,300rpm, CE.10,Cs.02,R.50m. Cycle time120/300=.40s; work4000J; ΔE400J.

omega31.416rad/s; I=400/(31.416²×.02)=20.264kg·m²; thin-rim mass=I/.25=81.06kg. આ ideal inertia requirement છે, complete safe design નહિ. Four-stroke માં60/N લેતાં work ખોટું અડધું થાય.

body.en:
A governor senses speed and changes the engine/prime-mover input to regulate mean speed when load changes. Centrifugal governors use rotating balls, arms, spindle and a sleeve connected to a throttle/fuel/steam control. Equilibrium speed is a steady operating speed for a given sleeve position; governor height is the vertical geometry used in its equilibrium model.

A stable governor has increasing equilibrium speed with increasing radius. Sensitiveness relates speed range to mean speed; hunting is repeated oscillation of speed/control. Friction produces a dead band. Governor effort is the mean force available at the sleeve for a specified lift; power is effort×lift, conventionally work capacity, not continuous shaft watts.
body.gu:
Governor speed sense કરીને fuel/steam/input બદલે, load change પછી mean speed regulate કરે. Balls,arms,spindle,sleeve અને control linkage parts. Sleeve position માટે steady speed=equilibrium speed; height equilibrium geometry નો vertical measure.

Stable governor માં radius વધતાં equilibrium speed વધે. Sensitiveness speed range સાથે સંબંધિત; hunting repeated oscillation. Friction dead band આપે. Governor effort sleeve માટે mean force; effort×lift conventionally work capacity, continuous watts નહિ.

body.en:
Construction: two balls are attached to upper arms pivoted near the spindle top; lower links connect to a sliding sleeve. The simple Watt model neglects additional central sleeve load and friction.

Working: when speed rises, balls move outward and upward, lifting the sleeve; the control linkage reduces energy input. Falling speed reverses the motion. For the ideal geometry, omega²=g/h, or h≈895/N² metres for N in rpm. It is most suitable for relatively low-speed regulation; do not use the relation for Porter/Proell without their load and geometry factors.
body.gu:
Construction: spindle top પાસે upper arms પર balls, lower links sliding sleeve સુધી. Simple Watt model extra central load/friction neglect કરે.

Speed વધતાં balls outward/upward, sleeve ઉપર અને control input ઘટાડે; speed ઘટતાં reverse. Ideal omega²=g/h અથવા h≈895/N² metres,N rpm. Relatively low speed માટે. Porter/Proell માટે load/geometry factors વગર આ relation નહિ.

body.en:
Porter construction: Watt-like arms and balls plus a substantial central load on the sleeve. Working: balls must balance both their weight and sleeve-load effect, allowing higher equilibrium speed for a given height than the simple Watt case. The amount depends on arm geometry and load.

Proell construction: a loaded sleeve arrangement with the balls carried on extensions of the lower arms rather than directly at the upper/lower-arm joints. Working remains centrifugal sensing and sleeve control, but the ball position and linkage leverage change the equilibrium characteristics. Do not call Proell merely a heavier Watt governor: show the extended lower arms and actual ball locations.
body.gu:
Porter માં Watt જેવા arms/balls સાથે sleeve પર central load. Balls પોતાના weight સાથે sleeve-load effect balance કરે; same height માટે simple Watt કરતાં equilibrium speed વધારે, geometry/load પર આધારિત.

Proell માં loaded sleeve અને balls lower arms ની extensions પર હોય, joint પર નહિ. Centrifugal sensing/sleeve control same principle પરંતુ leverage/equilibrium બદલાય. Diagram માં lower-arm extensions અને ball locations બતાવો.

h.en: 5.2.4 Flywheel versus governor and safe demonstration
h.gu: 5.2.4 Flywheel સામે Governor અને Safe Demonstration

body.en:
Flywheel: stores/returns kinetic energy, limits within-cycle speed variation, responds through inertia, and does not adjust supply. Governor: changes energy supply, regulates average speed under load variation, and needs an input-control linkage. A machine may need both.

In a supervised isolated model, identify spindle, balls, sleeve, load and control direction; move it slowly and trace input reduction when sleeve rises. A governor is not automatically an independent overspeed trip. Never adjust or approach exposed rotating balls, flywheels or belts during operation; failure can release high-energy fragments.
body.gu:
Flywheel inertia થી kinetic energy store/return કરી cycle અંદર fluctuation ઘટાડે; supply બદલતું નથી. Governor supply બદલી load variation સામે mean speed regulate કરે. Machine માં બંને હોઈ શકે.

Isolated supervised model પર spindle,balls,sleeve,load/control direction ઓળખો. Sleeve rise થી input reduction trace કરો. Governor independent overspeed trip જ છે એવું નહિ. Exposed rotating parts પાસે adjustment કરવું નહિ.

items.f:
Cs=(Nmax−Nmin)/Nmean
ΔE≈I omega² Cs; E=I omega²/2
CE=ΔE/Wcycle; thin rim I≈mR²

terms.en: Use rad/s for omega; four-stroke single-cylinder cycle time=120/N seconds.
terms.gu: Omega rad/s; four-stroke single-cylinder cycle time120/N seconds.

terms.en: Only the ideal unloaded-sleeve Watt geometry.

q.en: Why is flywheel mass near the rim?

a.en: It produces more moment of inertia per unit mass.
a.gu: દર unit mass માટે વધુ inertia આપે.

q.en: What happens above mean resisting torque?
What does torque-angle area represent?

a.en: Work, with angle measured in radians.
a.gu: Angle radians માં હોય તો work.

q.en: What is maximum energy fluctuation?

a.en: Difference between maximum and minimum accumulated cycle-energy levels.

q.en: Four-stroke cycle angle?
Define Cs.
Is stored energy equal to exchanged energy?

a.en: No; exchanged ΔE is only the cycle variation.

q.en: What does a governor regulate?

a.en: Mean speed by changing energy input as load changes.
a.gu: Load બદલાતાં input બદલી mean speed.

q.en: What distinguishes Porter?
Where are Proell balls?

a.en: On extensions of the lower arms.

q.en: What is hunting?

a.en: Repeated oscillation of speed and governing action.

q.en: Can a flywheel replace a governor?

a.en: No; they solve different speed-variation problems.
